content:
President Donald Trump has frequently bashed all of his recent predecessors in the Oval Office, especially former President George W. Bush.

But a new split video on CNN shows just how much Trump sounds like Bush when it comes to their wars in the Middle East.

Trump has called Bush’s war with Iraq, “one of the dumbest things I’ve ever seen,” the “worst single mistake ever made in the history of our country,” and “a big, fat mistake.”

Now, Trump seems to be in his own Middle East quagmire in Iran. When he launched the war more than six months ago, he said it would be over in a matter of weeks, even insisting several times that the United States already “won” and that he had “destroyed 100% of Iran’s Military capability.”

But, more than six months later, the war isn’t over, and the Iranian military continues to launch strikes.

As CNN pointed out, Trump and others in his administration increasingly sound like Bush as they talk about the increasingly unpopular war.
